boundary.resolution: All seventeen installed String exports plus the separate named floating-point decoder import: nine base operations, formatting, four pattern searches/substitutions and three packet interfaces; String codepoints remain distinct from mapped encoded bytes. Book II software scope.

registers.resolution: Actual signatures, argument/default/result procedures; complete format conversions, pattern constructs and packet tokens/controls/widths/alignment. These ordinary BIOS calls are not a mapped register bank.

datapath.resolution: Codepoint selection/construction, ASCII mapping, exact substring and lead-driven UTF-8 reads; format field/sign/prefix/padding order, signed/U32 and fixed/scientific/general/quoted construction, default numeric-text dependency and actual installed two-result %c delivery. Pattern candidate/capture/backtracking/iterator and replacement branches; exact empty-match advancement; packet endian/alignment/X lookahead, integer-safe-range/read-order, fixed/terminated/prefixed text and explicit float equations. The inherited SETT/rawset refill hold is resolved by f13fad92f; accepted Table operands and ordinary helper Tables consume the CPU-owned maintained-length contract.

visibility.resolution: Ordinary ordered calls and mapped reads, String construction rather than a live byte view, caller-owned source stable during decoding and demonstrated reuse after return; no atomic snapshot or rollback promise.

timing.resolution: Ordinary instruction/helper work, repeated codepoint scans, intermediate Tables/Strings, repeated doubling, 256-codepoint decoder staging and value-dependent format padding/scaling/normalization/base conversion; no fixed total-cycle, physical bandwidth or arbitrary-size resource guarantee. Pattern candidate scans/backtracking and packet digit/float-normalization/Table work are explicit; substitution count and lazy iteration are not per-call work budgets.

interrupts.resolution: CPU/IRQ chapters supply delivery and waiting; these ordinary library functions add no separate IRQ-control interface or interrupt-wait replacement.

faults.resolution: Reached primitive argument/length and scalar-validity errors, mapped accesses, exact incomplete/unsupported format error Strings and ordered star consumption; no validating UTF-8 parser or universal wrapper/type validator. Reached pattern errors and deferred validation, replacement-kind checks, packet parser/range/size/position/terminator errors are stated without importing stock Lua behavior.

reset.resolution: BIOS startup supplies the public String Table and String-index installation. Memory/CPU supply startup/reset; no per-function hardware reset or universal binding/history restoration is introduced.

programming.resolution: Short formatting, pattern, binary-record and raw floating-point-word examples accompany codepoint/byte distinctions, packet layouts, results and errors.
open: Existing CPU7 questions remain separate; the resolved Table producer does not close those source/compiler questions.
